messages:
Tori H.: hi all — quick heads up, my calendar shows tomorrow's new-hire orientation at 09:00 but I think that's my local DST shift. no Zoom link on the tile either. anyone else seeing weird times? :confused:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Tori! Official meeting: https://zoom.us/j/555666777 (passcode: `Welcome2026`). Calendar invites were sent in two flavors (Google and Outlook). If you see the wrong timezone, try removing and re-adding the event using this .ics: https://redwood.app/ical/onboard_master.ics.
Miguel A.: i had that too — Outlook interpreted it in GMT+1 instead of BST. fixed by accepting the invite from "People Ops (Onboarding)" and then doing a manual sync.
Rae P.: recording note: we'll record and put recording + transcript in Drive under Drive > Company > New Hires. I'll post the Drive link in #new-hires after processing. If you rely on captions, enable Live Transcript in Zoom.
Tori H.: great — will the transcript include closed captions for breakout rooms?
Rae P.: main room transcript will be available; breakout rooms are not transcribed by default. If you need captioning in breakouts, ping your facilitator and we can enable additional recording or assign a notetaker.
People Ops: quick checklist for tomorrow: 1) join 5 mins early to confirm audio/video, 2) have Slack open for links, 3) flag accessibility needs in advance (DM Rae). We'll keep the session ~75 mins with a short Q&A.
Tori H.: thanks! last tiny ask — is there an Outlook-friendly meeting link? some folks on my team don't use Zoom native client.
Onboarding Bot: The Zoom invite should redirect. For Outlook web client, use the join URL above. If your org blocks Zoom, DM People Ops and we can provide a Teams dial-in bridge for you.
Miguel A.: FYI — if your calendar shows duplicates after accepting, try clearing local cache in the calendar app; that fixed my ghost events.
Tori H.: all set, accepted the People Ops event and saved the Zoom link. see you tomorrow :wave:
